abstract: PURPOSE: A survey of stage I testicular tumors in the Chugoku-Shikoku district was taken in order to explore the clinical characteristics. PATIENTS AND METHODS: Three hundred and forty eight cases of stage I testicular tumor treated at 46 facilities in the Chugoku-Shikoku district between 1984 and 1992 were collected. Subjects' background factors, treatment methods and prognosis were studied. RESULTS: Tissue types were 249 (71.6%) seminoma and 99 (28.4%) non-seminoma. Adjuvant therapy for seminoma cases included 138 post-operative radiotherapy (4 recurrences, 3 cancer deaths), 57 chemotherapy (no recurrences, 2 contralateral testis tumor cases) and 48 were under surveillance (no recurrence). Adjuvant therapy for non-seminoma cases included 47 chemotherapy (1 recurrence) and retroperitoneal lymph node dissection was performed on 6 cases. Forty cases were under surveillance (1 recurrence). Of 8 (2.3%) cases with recurrence, 6 showed onset within two years and 2 after two years. Four of the 8 cases with recurrence were seminoma (1.1% of seminoma cases) and the other 4 were non-seminoma (4.0% of non-seminoma cases). All 3 (0.9% of all cases) of the cancer death cases were seminoma that received post-operative radiotherapy, while there were no cancer deaths in non-seminoma cases. CONCLUSION: Prognosis of stage I testicular tumor is good. Although the recurrence rate was higher in non-seminoma cases, cancer deaths were only observed in seminoma cases.
abstract_ja:
目的：中国・四国地方における病期I精巣腫瘍の臨床的特徴を明らかにするため調査を行った。
対象と方法：1984年から1992年の間に中国・四国地方の46施設で治療された病期I精巣腫瘍348例を集計し、患者の背景因子、治療法、予後を検討した。
結果：組織型は、セミノーマ249例（71.6%）、非セミノーマ99例（28.4%）であった。セミノーマ症例の補助療法は、術後放射線療法138例（再発4例、がん死3例）、化学療法57例（再発なし、対側精巣腫瘍2例）、サーベイランス48例（再発なし）であった。非セミノーマ症例の補助療法は、化学療法47例（再発1例）であり、後腹膜リンパ節郭清は6例に施行された。サーベイランスは40例（再発1例）であった。
再発8例（2.3%）のうち、6例は2年以内、2例は2年後に発症した。再発8例のうち4例はセミノーマ（セミノーマ症例の1.1%）、残る4例は非セミノーマ（非セミノーマ症例の4.0%）であった。全症例の3例（0.9%）のがん死はすべて術後放射線療法を受けたセミノーマであり、非セミノーマではがん死はみられなかった。
結論：病期I精巣腫瘍の予後は良好である。非セミノーマで再発率は高かったが、がん死はセミノーマでのみ認められた。
